hook_rules: Lead with the myth stated as if you believe it, then hard-cut on 'wrong'. The contradiction is the hook. First 1.5s must contain the false belief the viewer already holds.

beats.purpose: state the common belief out loud, confidently, as bait
puncture it — one line, high energy, pattern interrupt
the actual truth and the quick reason it's true
what the viewer gains by knowing this now
snap recap + soft CTA in one breath
